name: overflow
description: Dogfood build: at or below 80% Codex allowance, delegate work to friends running visible Overflow earning tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Keep working when Codex is nearly out.
interface.longDescription: After installing, open Overflow's Hooks section, review the SessionStart hook, and trust it; Codex skips untrusted hooks instead of automatically approving them. Overflow then checks your main Codex allowance when a session starts. This dogfood build triggers at or below 80% so the requester loop can be tested; the intended product threshold is 10%. A friend opens a visible task and runs /earn; that task claims the order, renames itself, performs the work on screen, and returns the artifact to the original conversation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use /work to delegate from this task, or /earn to take one queued Overflow task visibly.
